native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55
native.note: Host panel is the measurement. RegSetValueExW result 1 is not red 99. Restore of 10 is not onset.

finshield.method: panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 plus full-frame minus taskbar and 320x180 panel band
finshield.note: Panel stayed white 10. WinError 5 and KEY_ALL_ACCESS text are not the desktop measurement.
